description: This Dart source file defines a list of sample recipes used in a recipe exploration app. It imports a 'recipe.dart' model, then creates a constant list of 'Recipe' objects with detailed properties such as id, title, imageUrl, ingredients, steps, durationMinutes, servings, and tags. Additionally, it provides a map for quick lookup of recipes by id.

methods.name: kSampleRecipes
methods.description: A list of sample 'Recipe' instances used as seed data for browsing and search features.

methods.name: kSampleRecipesById
methods.description: A map from recipe IDs to corresponding 'Recipe' instances for quick lookup.
